answer: A farm of 337 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are published in dawn, queued in lagoon, and trellis publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 33 identities per epoch. A farm of 4909 identities would post 2508 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
